scripts.ci:repo: pnpm repo:guard && pnpm exec tsx scripts/check_repo_static.ts --affected --base "${CI_BASE_REF:-origin/main}"
scripts.ci:contracts: pnpm --filter campus-contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter campus-contracts test && pnpm contracts:check && uv run --package campus-contracts python -m unittest discover -s packages/contracts/tests -t packages/contracts -q
scripts.ci:ingest: pnpm --filter ingestion-contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter ingestion-contracts test && uv run --package campus-ingestion-contracts python -m unittest discover -s packages/ingestion-contracts/tests -t packages/ingestion-contracts -q
scripts.ci:eval: pnpm --dir packages/eval-langfuse typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/eval-langfuse test && pnpm --dir packages/eval-langfuse exec tsx src/cli.ts audit --json && uv run --package campus-ragas-runner python -m unittest discover -s packages/ragas-runner/tests -t packages/ragas-runner -q && pnpm --dir apps/app-api exec vitest run -c vitest.node.config.mts test/telemetry.index.test.ts
scripts.ci:worker: pnpm web:test:worker && pnpm --dir apps/app-api exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/campus-agent-app-api-worker-bundle --env local && pnpm --dir apps/campus-web build:app && pnpm --dir apps/operator-console-web build
scripts.ci:config: pnpm ci:actions:lint && uvx zizmor --min-severity=medium .github && pnpm exec tsx scripts/check_repo_static.ts --ci-workflows
scripts.ci:deps: go run github.com/google/osv-scanner/v2/cmd/osv-scanner@v2.3.8 scan source --config osv-scanner.toml --format=vertical --verbosity=error --lockfile pnpm-lock.yaml --lockfile uv.lock
scripts.go:check: test -z "$(gofmt -l apps/execution-control)" && cd apps/execution-control && go vet ./... && export PATH="$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH" && if ! command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'golangci-lint v2.11.4 is required. Install it from https://golangci-lint.run/welcome/install/'; exit 1; fi && golangci-lint run ./... && go test ./...
